description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Kotakadeniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320238
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including cadastral map numbers, block numbers, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and amendments to land extent measurements and administrative boundaries. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land title registration matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
